item.title: Ohio State Breaks Single-Game Record With 18 3-Pointers in 87-68 Road Win Over No. 15 Michigan State
item.description: Ohio State women’s basketball finished its regular season with a record-breaking performance against a top-15 team. The Buckeyes broke their single-game school record for 3-pointers in a game as Ohio State made 18 of 32 3-point shot attempts on their way to a 87-68 win over No. 15 Michigan State in East Lansing. item.title: Massive 82-74 Upset Win Over No. 8 Purdue Revives Ohio State in NCAA Tournament Race
item.description: For roughly the 10,000th time this season, when it seemed Ohio State's NCAA Tournament hopes were on life support, the Buckeyes took themselves from a great valley to a mountaintop. Coming off perhaps its worst performance of the season at Iowa, Ohio State banded together behind a scorching outing from John Mobley Jr. and stunned No. 8 Purdue (22-7, 12-7 Big Ten) in the Schottenstein Center in an 80-71 win. item.title: Paul Keels to Be Inducted Into the Ohio Basketball Hall of Fame
item.description: The “Voice of the Buckeyes” will be inducted into the Ohio Basketball Hall of Fame this June. Paul Keels is one of 14 men and women in the 2026 induction class, a group comprising former players, coaches, officials, and administrators. He is the lone broadcaster in the group. Keels has called Ohio State football and men’s basketball games since 1998.
